objective: Make self-compaction reliable and understandable when session readiness is stale or a user message interrupts the final authorization window.
end_user_job: Request one compaction, continue interacting if needed, and receive one clear terminal result without losing the request, the user message, the active autopilot objective, or private compaction instructions.

observed_failures.result: The detached verifier canceled before publication because no fresh session request-extension heartbeat existed.
observed_failures.user_effect: The tool had appeared armed, but no compaction occurred and the terminal transcript did not clearly expose the terminal status.

observed_failures.result: The detached verifier canceled before publication because a new root user message followed helper completion.
observed_failures.user_effect: The interruption was preserved, but the compact operation had no durable user-visible pending or retry state.

observed_failures.result: The two-phase active-autopilot path completed one token-bound compaction, checkpoint, continuation, and objective restoration.
observed_failures.user_effect: The safe path works, but the preceding failed attempts were indistinguishable from the final success until logs were inspected.

existing_capabilities: The self-compact extension can pause and privately stage an active autopilot objective.
The detached verifier binds one private brief to one tool-call identity and deduplicated compact request.
The shared session request extension exposes generation-bound heartbeats and transports send, autopilot, compact, and reload requests.
The verifier can restore the exact autopilot objective after verified success or a definitive pre-publication failure.
The session request extension can deliver a fixed immediate prompt and confirm its native delivery event.

deciding_runtime_facts.fact: The foreground self_compact tool returns its handoff receipt and its assistant turn ends before the detached verifier classifies later root activity.
deciding_runtime_facts.evidence: skills/self-compact/scripts/submit-compact.mjs returns after writing the handoff; resume-after-compact.mjs performs authorization and cancellation in the detached verifier.

deciding_runtime_facts.fact: A user interruption can therefore arrive after the requesting agent turn has ended, and the resulting user turn does not receive the detached cancellation status as tool output.
deciding_runtime_facts.evidence: Run 06a0c04e-20260922T035109Z-70258 canceled on the user.message event after helper completion; the user observed only the prior armed handoff.

deciding_runtime_facts.fact: Without active autopilot or a later control prompt, no deterministic mechanism schedules the same private brief for another final tool call.
deciding_runtime_facts.evidence: The successful third demonstration occurred only after a new active autopilot objective caused another prepare/final-call sequence.

hard_boundaries: A new user message must never be dropped, rewritten, or submitted by terminal automation.
Private compact instructions must not be copied into visible assistant or user prose.
A changed user instruction must be able to cancel or supersede a pending compact.
No ambiguous or post-publication outcome may be retried automatically.
At most one compact request and one continuation may be accepted for one operation.
Autopilot may be paused temporarily but its exact objective must be restored or an explicit terminal failure retained.
challenge_question: What is the minimum design that gives one clear, durable compact operation across stale readiness and user interruption while preserving the existing fail-closed publication boundary?
